article.title: Discharge of surety when creditor compounds with, gives time to, or agrees not to sue, principal debtor.
article.content: A contract between the creditor and the principal debtor, by which the creditor makes a composition with, or promises to give time to, or not to sue, the principal debtor, discharges the surety, unless the surety assents to such contract.
article.html:
135Discharge of surety when creditor compounds with, gives time to, or agrees not to sue, principal debtor.

Section 135 · Chapter VIII · page 36 of the Act

A contract between the creditor and the principal debtor, by which the creditor makes a composition with, or promises to give time to, or not to sue, the principal debtor, discharges the surety, unless the surety assents to such contract.
